trace_scope: request identities/acceptance/input seeds only; no full-model sequence-length execution
includes: casts, base products, correction, solve, accepted-base commit, new logs, output and all device completion
dense_export: all four logical candidates exported for correctness; compact_export_all measures an all-dense consumer
excludes: convolution, real layer/model, FIA host updates, TP communication, trace preparation and dispatch
lifecycle: sequential request generations only; production stale/retry/reuse validation not integrated

request_pipeline.capacity: unchanged full bucket and global input/products/state/log buffers
request_pipeline.serial: cast full Q/K and clear output once; P_A, S_A, P_B, S_B
request_pipeline.concurrent: P_A -> (S_A on side stream || P_B on capture stream) -> S_B -> capture-stream join
request_pipeline.timing: complete range operations, casts, clear, event waits and final join; no full-model claim

memory.scope: both controls, all graphs, exports and correctness snapshots; not incremental model peak
